name: Equity Release (UK)
notes: Scaffold live at https://equity-release.pages.dev (placeholder + /plan/ hub) as of 1 Jun 2026. BANKED 26 May 2026 (research-stage only, no build yet). UK equity release lead-gen / authority site. Lead-sells qualified enquiries to FCA-authorised equity release advisers at ~£90-150 CPL (RMT Direct / LeadCrowd benchmarks). Scored 20/25 on the niche-attack scorecard. Organic mere-introducer model (RAO Art.33) + Introducer Appointed Representative (IAR) under an authorised principal for the 'find an adviser' CTA (FSMA s.21 approver gateway, since 7 Feb 2024). Sibling: RIO/later-life lending (the can-service-interest alternative within the same advisory lane). On-site upsell clusters (Kevin Bacon run): Care-fees funding (release equity vs immediate-needs annuity) + Gifted deposit / Bank of Mum & Dad (release equity to gift kids a deposit). Spin-out option: pension-income (annuity 5,400 + drawdown 4,400 = 10k+/mo combined). Research files: iCloud/.../niche-discovery-2026-05-26/09-equity-release-leadgen-brief.md + KEVIN-BACON-equity-release.md.

pending_decisions.note: Equity-release adviser network. Principal notifies FCA 30 days before appointment. Cost: network fee (few hundred to few thousand pounds/year) + referral split. Compliance consultant can broker. IAR keeps us inside RAO Art.33 (introducing to authorised firm) AND lets us run an FCA-approved 'find an adviser' CTA under FSMA s.21.
